quote: I do not wish them to have power over men; but over themselves.
source: Mary Wollstonecraft, A Vindication of the Rights of Woman, chapter 4, answering Rousseau on the education of women (1792)

evidence.where: Full text of A Vindication of the Rights of Woman read at Project Gutenberg ebook 3420 and cross-checked against the Marxists Internet Archive chapter 4 page; the sentence stands in chapter 4 with the semicolon as proposed
evidence.edition: A Vindication of the Rights of Woman (1792), chapter 4
evidence.locator: chapter 4, Observations on the State of Degradation to Which Woman Is Reduced by Various Causes, immediately after the quotation from Rousseau

reason: Located in chapter 4, where it answers Rousseau's line that educating women lessens their power over men. The chapter title is too long to ride inside a 140 character source, so the source names chapter 4 and what she is answering, which locates the passage on the page. Wollstonecraft goes to three of three for the year with this line.
